name: Prompt → moodboard → Unity UI with 9-slice (Claude Code)
description: An LLM writes moodboard shots, images are generated per shot and laid out as a moodboard. A UI kit sheet in the same style is generated, auto-sliced into elements with estimated 9-slice borders, and local Claude Code imports everything into your Unity project: sprites with borders, sliced Image prefabs and a demo canvas.

params.name: prompt
params.value: cozy dark-fantasy RPG, carved wood and brass, warm candle light

params.system: You are an art director for game UI.
params.prompt: Write 4 short image prompts for a moodboard that defines the visual style of a game UI: {{inputs.prompt}}. Mix: a key art scene, a material/texture close-up, a color palette swatch board, and an example HUD screen.

Game UI kit sprite sheet in this style: {{inputs.prompt}}. Separate, non-overlapping elements on a perfectly flat pure white background with generous spacing: 3 buttons (normal, hover, pressed), a large panel frame, a small window frame, a progress bar frame, a tab, a slider knob, 4 round icon slots. Flat orthographic view, no text, no shadows on the background.

You are working in a Unity project. Integrate a generated UI kit:
1. Copy every slice image listed in the context into Assets/UI/Generated/Sprites/ (keep file names). Copy the moodboard image to Assets/UI/Generated/moodboard.png.
2. For each sprite create/modify its .meta so the importer uses Texture Type: Sprite (2D and UI), Sprite Mode: Single, Mesh Type: Full Rect, alphaIsTransparency: 1, and set spriteBorder (x=left, y=bottom, z=right, w=top) from the slice data below. Skip borders when 'stretchable' is false.
3. Create prefabs in Assets/UI/Generated/Prefabs/: one UI Image prefab per element with Image Type = Sliced for stretchable sprites, Simple otherwise. Name them by what they look like (Button_Normal, Panel_Large, ...) — look at the images.
4. Create Assets/Scenes/GeneratedUIDemo.unity with a Canvas (Scale With Screen Size 1920x1080) that lays the prefabs out as a sample menu matching the moodboard mood.
5. If Unity is open with an MCP bridge, refresh assets; otherwise it is fine to only write files. Summarize what you created.
